lines.2: 「S-So, did you record that drama I mentioned?」
lines.9: 「I told you... I am poor with machines.」
lines.12: 「Y-You are the one at fault for demanding such an advanced technique as recording a television program!」
lines.13: 「See, you just press this little button right heeere.」
lines.14: 「Perhaps I imagined it, but that felt insulting.」
lines.15: I decided discretion was the better part of valor.
lines.18: Whoa. She chased me all the way upstairs.
lines.19: I dashed into my room and started closing the door--
